SELECT count(t1.`id`) as total FROM `todo_task` t1 INNER JOIN `todo_person` t2 on t1.`id` = t2.`todo_task_id`
t2.`user_id` = #{userId} and t1.`status` = 'TODO' and t2.`status` = 'TODO' and t1.`task_del_state` = 0

SELECT t1.`business_type`, t1.`business_type_name`, count(t1.`id`) as total FROM `todo_task` t1 INNER JOIN `todo_person` t2 on t1.`id` = t2.`todo_task_id`
t2.`user_id` = #{userId} and t1.`status` = 'TODO' and t2.`status` = 'TODO' and t1.`task_del_state` = 0
group by t1.`business_type`

t2.`user_id` = #{userId} and t1.`status` = 'TODO' and t2.`status` = 'TODO' and t1.`task_del_state` = 0
group by t1.`business_type`

SELECT t1.`business_type`, t1.`business_type_name` FROM `todo_task` t1 INNER JOIN `todo_person` t2 on t1.`id` = t2.`todo_task_id`
